decisions.authority: SO0 reporting/read-model/report-automation constitution and XA reporting surfaces
decisions.decision: Adopt the frozen SO0 assignment of operational reporting, read models and report automation to SO9 while reusing PC5 authorization and XA presentation boundaries.

Map the tenant-specific cross-domain reporting service as compatibility-only legacy reporting. Do not promote branch, TreasuryLog or legacy financial calculation assumptions into SO9 neutral authority.

decisions.authority: legacy report/dashboard readers and source-domain projections
decisions.decision: Bridge prospectively through explicit source-authority/read-model definitions and rebuildable snapshots. Source domains remain canonical and SO9 never writes their private state.

decisions.authority: Neutral Finance statements, traces, reconciliation reports and other frozen financial read models
decisions.decision: Preserve Finance-owned report semantics and bytes. SO9 may consume approved financial read contracts but never recalculates or replaces canonical financial reporting truth.

decisions.authority: legacy core reports writers/readers and direct cross-domain report SQL
decisions.decision: Retire only after source-specific neutral adapters, packs and R6 production cutover prove equivalent behavior. No bulk rewrite is performed in SO9.
